              Met Office names Staffordshire in latest snow forecast

              You've been warned!

              Comments3
              News
              Rob Andrews Head of Content
              09:53, 25 Nov 2026
              Listen to audio version of this article
              Sponsored by
              0:00 / 1:04
              Instaread

              The Met Office has listed Staffordshire in its latest snow forecast. Some parts of the country could see snowfall this week as the Met Office predicts the weather maps will turn white in 17 areas across England and Scotland.

              ‌
              ‌

              Temperatures have dropped in the past few days, with the start of meteorological winter just around the corner, on December 1. Forecasts for the start of this week showed heavy showers but this could be replaced by white flurries.

              ‌

              Met Office meteorologist Dan Harris said: "As milder Atlantic air encounters the colder air already in place, there is a possibility of snow and perhaps freezing rain for a time over higher ground in parts of northern Britain on Friday. At present, significant accumulations at lower levels look unlikely, but people should keep an eye on the forecast for the latest updates."
